custom_llm_guide.title: Custom LLM Integration
custom_llm_guide.description: This guide explains how to easily integrate custom models into the simulation, allowing researchers to upload and use their own LLMs in any supported format.

steps.title: Step 1: Prepare Your Model
content: Prepare your custom LLM in any format, such as `.pt` for PyTorch or `.h5` for TensorFlow.
Ensure your model is set for inference mode (e.g., evaluation mode for PyTorch).
Add metadata to help identify the model during simulation (e.g., model ID, author).

steps.title: Step 2: Upload Your Model
content: Select the 'Custom' option under Red or Blue team setup on the website.
Upload your model file directly in the upload section.
The system will automatically save the model with the appropriate team prefix (e.g., `red_` or `blue_`).

steps.title: Step 3: Integration into Simulation
content: The backend will automatically detect and load the uploaded model.
The model will be used for generating messages and influencing node alignments during the simulation.

steps.title: Step 4: Verify Model Usage
content: During the simulation, the frontend will display the model ID to confirm your custom model is in use.
Check the simulation dashboard for model information and outputs.

steps.title: Step 5: Update Your Model
content: To replace the current model, simply upload a new one.
The system will replace the old model and use the new one for future simulations.
